responsibility: Provides the Darwin 10.x version-specific target configuration overlay on top of the common Darwin headers. It adjusts the linker command sequence so libSystem is linked before libgcc_ext for affected deployment targets, injects the special unwind support object for the 10.6-only window, and sets the default minimum deployment target and baseline ld64 version expected for this OS generation. Its role is therefore release-specific Darwin driver/spec policy rather than generic Mach-O backend implementation.
